title: Problems after changing libre sensor
body:
Hi everyone!

I have a problem, could you help me?

I changed Glimp to xDrip+- amazing app! I use libre+blucon for BG level monitoring.
A couple days ago I changed libre sensor (stop/start sensor in app) and battery in blucon. And something went wrong: no data (exept battery level and sensor age) in app((

I've tried everything that can imagine: 
- changed the battery in blucon
- re-add blucon BT
- used different app version (last stable, last nightly)

Right now xDrip's log filled with "received historic data, m_block_number=" and it lasts for hours with different numbers((
Another strange point - there were no additional window (with 4 steps and calibration request) after sensor was changed.

I need help)

comments.body:
Can you provide screenshots?
otherwise you can check the how-to: 

https://github.com/gregorybel/xDrip-plus/wiki/How-to-use-Blukon-with-xdrip

I assume you have calibrated your sensor?

Hi!

It seems to me that changing options during initial sequence can easily break everything((

Everything fine since complete app removing and installing again.

@IgnisAsphodel It seems the problem was resolved.  Would you please close the issue then?
Thanks
